The code is MIT licensed. We distilled a BERT-base sentiment model (110M parameters, 92.55% on SST-2) into BERT-Mini (11M parameters) on a laptop CPU with no GPU. We expected the usual story: the student learns from the teacher's soft targets and beats a student trained on labels alone. That's not what happened.
